dashboard.label: My Accesses
dashboard.description: Effective rights of the logged-in user: roles, searchable indexes, apps, search quotas, capabilities.

search.query: | rest splunk_server=local /services/authentication/current-context | fields username roles capabilities
| eventcount summarize=false index=* index=_* | stats sum(count) as events by index | eval type=if(match(index, "^_"), "internal", "data")

| rest splunk_server=local /services/apps/local count=0 | search disabled=0 (visible=1 OR visible=true) | eval access=if('eai:acl.can_write'="1" OR 'eai:acl.can_write'="true", "read/write", "read") | rename title as id | table label access id
| fields roles | mvexpand roles | eval count=1 | table roles count

| rest splunk_server=local /services/authorization/roles count=0 | search [| rest splunk_server=local /services/authentication/current-context | fields roles | mvexpand roles | rename roles as title] | table title imported_roles | rename title as Role, imported_roles as "Inherits from"
| search type="$f_type$" $f_idx$ | sort index | table index type events

| rest splunk_server=local /services/authorization/roles count=0 | search [| rest splunk_server=local /services/authentication/current-context | fields roles | mvexpand roles | rename roles as title] | eval jobs=max(coalesce(srchJobsQuota, 0), coalesce(imported_srchJobsQuota, 0)), rt=max(coalesce(rtSrchJobsQuota, 0), coalesce(imported_rtSrchJobsQuota, 0)), disk=max(coalesce(srchDiskQuota, 0), coalesce(imported_srchDiskQuota, 0)), win=mvappend(srchTimeWin, imported_srchTimeWin), earl=mvappend(srchTimeEarliest, imported_srchTimeEarliest), filter=mvappend(srchFilter, imported_srchFilter) | stats max(jobs) as jobs_quota max(rt) as rt_quota max(disk) as disk_quota min(win) as win_min max(win) as win_max min(earl) as earl_min max(earl) as earl_max values(filter) as filter | appendcols [| rest splunk_server=local /services/search/jobs count=0 | search author="$env:user$" | eval running=if(in(isDone, "0", "false"), 1, 0), rt=if(in(isRealTimeSearch, "1", "true"), 1, 0), sched=if(delegate="scheduler", 1, 0) | stats sum(eval(if(running=1 AND rt=0 AND sched=0, 1, 0))) as jobs_used sum(eval(if(running=1 AND rt=1, 1, 0))) as rt_used sum(diskUsage) as disk_bytes] | fillnull value=0 jobs_used rt_used disk_bytes | eval disk_used=round(disk_bytes/1024/1024, 1), win_eff=case(isnull(win_max), "n/a", win_min<=0, "unlimited", true(), tostring(win_max, "duration")), earl_eff=case(isnull(earl_max), "n/a", earl_min<=0, "unlimited", true(), tostring(earl_max, "duration")), filter=mvfilter(filter!=""), filter_eff=if(isnull(filter), "none", mvjoin(filter, " OR ")) | eval row=mvappend( "Concurrent searches§".jobs_quota."§".jobs_used, "Concurrent real-time searches§".rt_quota."§".rt_used, "Search results disk space (MB)§".disk_quota."§".disk_used, "Max time range per search§".win_eff."§", "Earliest searchable time (back from now)§".earl_eff."§", "Search filter§".filter_eff."§") | fields row | mvexpand row | rex field=row "^(?<Parameter>[^§]*)§(?<Limit>[^§]*)§(?<in_use>.*)$" | eval "Usage %"=if(isnum(tonumber(in_use)) AND tonumber(Limit)>0, round(100*tonumber(in_use)/tonumber(Limit), 0), null()) | rename in_use as "In use" | table Parameter Limit "In use" "Usage %"
| fields capabilities | mvexpand capabilities | rename capabilities as capability | sort capability
